We are seeing India swiftly shift from an IT service outsourcing-hub to an IP/Patent driven 'Product Nation' with compelling investment opportunities.

        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">We are delighted to welcome <a class="link" href="https://in.linkedin.com/in/roneet-parikh-5096b413a?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Roneet Parikh</a>, who joins YourNest as part of the Investment Growth team. In this role, he will work with early-stage companies in our portfolio, helping founders navigate the challenges of building and scaling their businesses. 

Roneet’s experience spans startup research, Founder’s Office roles at AI and tech startups, and building his own local delivery startup during the pandemic. Across these assignments, he developed a keen interest in technology-led businesses, especially AI and DeepTech. During his undergraduate degree he studied Computer Science at Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, and Innovation & Entrepreneurship at the University of Warwick for his Master's. Computer Science taught him to break down complex problems, while entrepreneurship gave him the business perspective to think about customers, markets and business models. 

What sets Roneet apart is his habit of taking ownership of problems rather than waiting to be told how to solve them. He gets close to the problem, speaks to the people involved and works out what would actually help. He prefers practical solutions that can be tested and improved over chasing perfection upfront. 

The YourNest team grows stronger with people who bring this kind of ownership and curiosity and we’re excited to see the impact he’ll make. 

Welcome aboard, Roneet!</p>

    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">Almost everyone who works for a living experiences what they call ‘Mondayitis’ at some point or the other… unless you’re either building something that’ll change the way we live, work and even play; or enabling the builders who are leveraging technology in ways unimagined. 

And that’s what we saw when a bunch of our Delhi NCR startup founders, the <a class="link" href="https://in.linkedin.com/company/yournest-venture-capital?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>YourNest Venture Capital</a>, Portfolio Managers and Functional Heads came over to Gurgaon yesterday evening. In a visible display of unflagging energy synonymous with entrepreneurs, conversations continued over cocktails (and nimbu-paani!). There was a sense of camaraderie – not just between old-timers but also folks who met for the first time yesterday. They came from as far as Jodhpur and Indore too, and established bonds that are sure to go further over time and geography. 

I had the unique experience of dining on Kung-pao Chicken with Jeera Rice – not quite fusion, but confusion! And we also had an uninvited guest that’s survived many millennia and has inspired the name of a protesting political party much in the news these days… but the creature was quickly expelled, much to the chagrin of the five-star hotel whose hygiene levels will certainly need an upgrade.

Most of the attendees are tagged in the photos here, but we also had many others who made the evening truly memorable! Thank you for being there.</p>

        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">We are delighted to welcome <a class="link" href="https://in.linkedin.com/in/shivanshu-mishra-101b6b1b1?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Shivanshu Mishra</a>, who joins YourNest as Senior Analyst in the Investment Management team. Shivanshu brings experience across DefenceTech, HealthTech, CleanTech, FinTech, AgriTech and enterprise SaaS, spanning early-stage venture and institutional investing. He holds an MBA in Finance & Strategy from IIM Raipur, and has a <a class="link" href="http://B.Tech?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" rel="nofollow" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>B.Tech</a> in Electronics from IET DAVV, Indore. He has also cleared CFA Level 1. His engineering background taught him to break problems into first principles, while finance taught him to price uncertainty. He rarely takes a number or a narrative at face value.

What sets Shivanshu apart is a habit of flagging problems before they become crises and not waiting until the deadline. He is happiest building structure where none exists, taking an ambiguous mandate and creating a framework that works under pressure. The YourNest team grows stronger with people who bring this kind of rigour and discipline, and we’re excited to see the impact he’ll make.

Welcome aboard, Shivanshu!</p>

Advait brings experience across the cultural and heritage sectors, with brief stints in academic research and public relations. He sees his role as helping ensure that innovation across the portfolio is matched by the systems and practices needed for sustainable growth. The YourNest team grows stronger with people who bring this kind of rigour and curiosity, and we're excited to see the impact he'll make.

Welcome aboard, Advait!</p>

    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗼𝗻𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗘𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗴𝘆 𝗧𝘂𝗿𝗻𝘀 𝟮𝟬𝟬 𝗜𝗖𝗘 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗼𝘀 𝗘𝗹𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰 𝗶𝗻 𝗕𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗹𝘂𝗿𝘂

<a class="link" href="https://in.linkedin.com/company/exponent-energy?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Exponent Energy</a> has completed 200 ICE-to-EV autorickshaw retrofits in Bengaluru through its Exponent OTO platform, demonstrating an alternative route to commercial vehicle electrification: converting vehicles already on the road instead of waiting for fleet replacement. 

𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗼𝘁 𝗦𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗨𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻

• 200 autorickshaws retrofitted during a four-month pilot
• Fleet has covered 1.5+ million km
• More than 25,000 charging sessions completed
• Exponent claims around 20% share of Bengaluru’s electric 3W market 

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘆

Exponent OTO combines the company’s battery, powertrain and vehicle software.

The retrofit can reportedly be completed in 24 hours, with a claimed 15-minute 0–100% charging time, 140–150 km real-world range and a five-year/3,000-cycle warranty. 

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗠𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀

India already has a massive installed base of ICE three-wheelers. Retrofitting could provide commercial drivers with a faster transition path while retaining the existing vehicle ecosystem.

Exponent is also using Exponent ONE to finance retrofit kits and reduce the upfront cost for drivers. The company plans to expand OTO to new electric three-wheelers through OEM partnerships as well. 

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗧𝗼 𝗪𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵

The key test now is scale beyond the pilot — retrofit economics, regulatory approvals, financing, battery life and charging utilisation will determine whether this model can move from 200 vehicles to thousands across Indian cities.

𝗘𝗩 𝗕𝘂𝗹𝗹𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗻 𝗧𝗮𝗸𝗲

India’s commercial EV transition doesn’t necessarily require replacing every ICE vehicle.

If retrofit platforms can make existing autorickshaws economically viable as EVs, they could create a parallel pathway to electrification — particularly in high-utilisation urban 3W fleets.
